evals.prompt: Write Kubernetes manifests into a file named manifests.yaml for the API of the ledger service. Team: payments. Environment: production. Cost center: 4127. Include a Deployment (image registry.acme.example/ledger-api:2.3.1, 2 replicas), a Service on port 80 that targets port 8080, and a ConfigMap with LOG_LEVEL=info.
evals.expected_output: manifests.yaml with a Deployment and a Service named ledger-api, a ConfigMap named ledger-api-cfg, all in namespace payments-prd, each carrying the labels acme.io/team=payments, acme.io/app=ledger, acme.io/env=prd, acme.io/cost-center=cc-4127 and app.kubernetes.io/name=ledger.
assertions: manifests.yaml exists
The Deployment and the Service are both named 'ledger-api'
The ConfigMap is named 'ledger-api-cfg'
Every resource is in the namespace 'payments-prd'
Every resource has the labels acme.io/team, acme.io/app, acme.io/env and acme.io/cost-center
The label acme.io/env is 'prd' and the label acme.io/cost-center is 'cc-4127'
No resource name contains the words prod, production, or prd

evals.prompt: Write Kubernetes manifests into a file named edge.yaml for the web frontend of the checkout app. Team: storefront. Environment: staging. Cost center: 2200. Include a Secret holding a TLS certificate (type kubernetes.io/tls, use placeholder data) and an Ingress for host checkout.acme.example that routes to a Service named checkout-web on port 80.
evals.expected_output: edge.yaml with a Secret named checkout-web-sec and an Ingress named checkout-web-ing, both in namespace storefront-stg, with the labels acme.io/team=storefront, acme.io/app=checkout, acme.io/env=stg and acme.io/cost-center=cc-2200.
assertions: edge.yaml exists
The Secret is named 'checkout-web-sec'
The Ingress is named 'checkout-web-ing'
Both resources are in the namespace 'storefront-stg'
The label acme.io/env is 'stg' on both resources
The label acme.io/cost-center is 'cc-2200' on both resources
The Ingress routes to the Service 'checkout-web'

evals.prompt: Write Kubernetes manifests into a file named report.yaml for a nightly report job of the ledger app. Team: payments. Environment: dev. Cost center: 4127. Include a CronJob that runs every night at 02:00 with image registry.acme.example/ledger-report:0.9.0, and a 5Gi PersistentVolumeClaim that the job mounts at /data.
evals.expected_output: report.yaml with a CronJob named ledger-report-cron and a PersistentVolumeClaim named ledger-report-pvc, both in namespace payments-dev, with the required acme.io labels and acme.io/env=dev.
assertions: report.yaml exists
The CronJob is named 'ledger-report-cron'
The PersistentVolumeClaim is named 'ledger-report-pvc'
Both resources are in the namespace 'payments-dev'
Both resources have the labels acme.io/team, acme.io/app, acme.io/env and acme.io/cost-center
The CronJob mounts the claim 'ledger-report-pvc' at /data
